claim: US Democratic presidential nominee Joe Biden was endorsed by Black Lives Matter and Antifa
justification: High-confidence evidence (confidence=0.95 and 0.90) establishes that Antifa is a decentralized movement without formal endorsement structures and has no documented instance of endorsing Joe Biden. For Black Lives Matter, high-confidence evidence (confidence=0.75 and 0.70) indicates that the organization did not endorse Biden in 2020 and was critical of both major parties, while low-confidence evidence claiming endorsement is discounted due to contradictions and reliability issues. Therefore, the claim that both Black Lives Matter and Antifa endorsed Joe Biden is refuted.
